title: 畜牧廢水資源回收概念
summary: 以「畜牧廢水固液分流與資源回收帳」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「稀釋造成濃度下降被當成污染物移除」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on Solid-liquid separation and resource accounts in livestock wastewater, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of Dilution mistaken for contaminant removal.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

steps.instructionEn: The case focus is Solid-liquid separation and resource accounts in livestock wastewater. Draw Feed water → Pretreatment → Separation unit → Product and concentrate → Paired samples and mark the interfaces relevant to Water recovery. steps.title: 單元1｜水量回收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Water recovery: Quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以「畜牧廢水固液分流與資源回收帳」完成定量估算並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for Solid-liquid separation and resource accounts in livestock wastewater with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「畜牧廢水固液分流與資源回收帳」的「水量回收」採以下合成教學值：product=4 L/s；feed=10 L/s。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 100*product/feed；獨立基準為 40 %。把 product 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 44 %。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Solid-liquid separation and resource accounts in livestock wastewater, use synthetic inputs for Water recovery: product=4 L/s；feed=10 L/s. Check dimensions before evaluating 100*product/feed; the independent benchmark is 40 %. Increase product by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 44 %. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: product增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 4 %。必須使用同一時間窗並計入反洗、排泥與庫存變化。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 4 %. Use one time window and account for backwash, sludge and storage change.
steps.failure: 稀釋造成濃度下降被當成污染物移除；必須使用同一時間窗並計入反洗、排泥與庫存變化。
steps.failureEn: Dilution mistaken for contaminant removal; Use one time window and account for backwash, sludge and storage change.
steps.check: 原值重算與 40 % 相符；10%案例與 44 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 40 % at baseline and 44 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（%）？
quiz.explanation: 按 100*product/feed 逐項代入，結果為 40；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into 100*product/feed gives 40; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元1｜水量回收：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Water recovery: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「畜牧廢水固液分流與資源回收帳」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Solid-liquid separation and resource accounts in livestock wastewater with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「畜牧廢水固液分流與資源回收帳」設計「水量回收」的獨立驗證：同時計量進水、產水與濃流，測試三股水量是否閉合。 用惰性數位水樣同時閉合水量與溶質帳，稀釋不當作移除。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Solid-liquid separation and resource accounts in livestock wastewater, independently verify Water recovery: Meter feed, product and concentrate simultaneously and test closure. Close water and solute accounts with inert digital samples; dilution is not removal. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「稀釋造成濃度下降被當成污染物移除」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Dilution mistaken for contaminant removal rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 稀釋造成濃度下降被當成污染物移除；必須使用同一時間窗並計入反洗、排泥與庫存變化。
steps.failureEn: Dilution mistaken for contaminant removal; Use one time window and account for backwash, sludge and storage change.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「必須使用同一時間窗並計入反洗、排泥與庫存變化。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Use one time window and account for backwash, sludge and storage change.

steps.title: 單元1｜水量回收：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Water recovery: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「畜牧廢水固液分流與資源回收帳」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。

steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「稀釋造成濃度下降被當成污染物移除」。以本單元「水量回收」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「同時計量進水、產水與濃流，測試三股水量是否閉合。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Dilution mistaken for contaminant removal. For Water recovery, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Meter feed, product and concentrate simultaneously and test closure. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「稀釋造成濃度下降被當成污染物移除」不是單靠 40 % 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 40 % alone cannot exclude Dilution mistaken for contaminant removal; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 稀釋造成濃度下降被當成污染物移除；必須使用同一時間窗並計入反洗、排泥與庫存變化。
steps.failureEn: Dilution mistaken for contaminant removal; Use one time window and account for backwash, sludge and storage change.
steps.check: 交付單元1的五項證據包；清楚寫出「畜牧廢水固液分流與資源回收帳」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。

steps.title: 單元2｜表觀截留：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Apparent rejection: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「畜牧廢水固液分流與資源回收帳」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Solid-liquid separation and resource accounts in livestock wastewater with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「畜牧廢水固液分流與資源回收帳」設計「表觀截留」的獨立驗證：配對取樣進水與產水，加入空白與已知濃度樣本檢查回收。 用惰性數位水樣同時閉合水量與溶質帳，稀釋不當作移除。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Solid-liquid separation and resource accounts in livestock wastewater, independently verify Apparent rejection: Take paired samples and include blanks and known-concentration checks. Close water and solute accounts with inert digital samples; dilution is not removal. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「稀釋造成濃度下降被當成污染物移除」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Dilution mistaken for contaminant removal rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 稀釋造成濃度下降被當成污染物移除；需要同一溶質和基準，不能取代完整溶質質量帳或品質判定。
steps.failureEn: Dilution mistaken for contaminant removal; Requires the same solute and basis; it does not replace a solute balance or quality judgment.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「需要同一溶質和基準，不能取代完整溶質質量帳或品質判定。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Requires the same solute and basis; it does not replace a solute balance or quality judgment.

steps.title: 單元2｜表觀截留：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Apparent rejection: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「畜牧廢水固液分流與資源回收帳」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Solid-liquid separation and resource accounts in livestock wastewater with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「稀釋造成濃度下降被當成污染物移除」。以本單元「表觀截留」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「配對取樣進水與產水，加入空白與已知濃度樣本檢查回收。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Dilution mistaken for contaminant removal. For Apparent rejection, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Take paired samples and include blanks and known-concentration checks. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「稀釋造成濃度下降被當成污染物移除」不是單靠 98 % 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 98 % alone cannot exclude Dilution mistaken for contaminant removal; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 稀釋造成濃度下降被當成污染物移除；需要同一溶質和基準，不能取代完整溶質質量帳或品質判定。
steps.failureEn: Dilution mistaken for contaminant removal; Requires the same solute and basis; it does not replace a solute balance or quality judgment.
steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「畜牧廢水固液分流與資源回收帳」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Solid-liquid separation and resource accounts in livestock wastewater and retaining failed cases.
